# Fixtures

- `schema_0001_baseline.sql`: the legacy schema used by `legacy_baseline_upgrade_matches_fresh_install`.
- `phase0_session.db`: a session database written by the build before the crate split (commit
  `1c26c972`, the task 0.1 baseline): one session (`fixture`), two messages, two durable events. Used by
  `existing_database_opens_after_crate_split` (task 5.3). It was generated by
  `phase0_session_generator.rs.txt`, copied as `crates/agent/examples/gen_fixture_db.rs` into a worktree
  at that commit and run with `cargo run -p querymt-agent --example gen_fixture_db -- <path>`;
  the WAL was then checkpointed so the file is self-contained. Do not regenerate it with newer code:
  its purpose is to be older than the code under test.
